faqs.question: What are the library timings?
faqs.answer: The central library is open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on all working days.

faqs.question: How do I apply for the hostel?
faqs.answer: Hostel room allocation is done via the student portal. You must pay the fee receipt at the warden's office to secure your room.

campusData.title: B.Tech Computer Science Admissions
campusData.content: Admission to the B.Tech CSE program requires a minimum of 60% in 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. Candidates must also qualify in the university entrance exam or JEE Mains.

campusData.title: Campus Transport and Buses
campusData.content: The university provides a fleet of 50+ buses covering a 50km radius. Bus passes are issued term-wise. Students must carry their ID cards to board the bus.
